correctness.rationale: For the corrected proof, independently reconstructed the supporting triangular and pentagonal facets, 60 edges, and 15 preserving reflections using integer pairs in Z[phi] on doubled midpoint coordinates. Grouped the 105 mirror pairs by their incident-mirror sets; exact (mirror multiplicity, strict crossings, on-plane vertices) triples were (2,4,4) on 15 axes, (3,0,6) on 10, and (5,0,10) on 6. A strict crossing of an edge is extreme in the section, and an on-plane vertex remains extreme; there are no other section vertices and coplanar edges contribute only their endpoints. The representative (1,2,4) has 12 strict crossings and three chamber corners of multiplicities 2,3,5. The reflections exchange adjacent chambers, so this suffices for every generic normal. The incidence count gives 62 points and 180 arcs, then Euler gives 120 chambers. The original Step 4 did not justify four crossings from central symmetry alone. In the corrected step, the eight incident edges contribute complementary crossings across the wall, and the equal generic totals force four on each side. They are replaced by two inherited vertices at the wall, giving 10. The numerical and geometric statement is unchanged; the measure-zero conclusion follows from the finite mirror union.
residual_risks: This is an exact mathematical and finite computational audit of section vertex counts only, not a formal proof certificate or a statement about metric or off-center sections.
